message:
The other night, we had an unexpected power outage that left the whole neighborhood in darkness. At first, I scrambled for my flashlight and power bank, but once I got the essentials sorted, I remembered the joy of a simpler time. 

We pulled out some board games and lit up our little living room with a cozy lantern. Laughter filled the air as we rediscovered low-tech fun, chatting and playing together without our usual screens. It turned out to be a delightful evening, reminding me that sometimes, disconnecting can bring us closer together. 

What’s your favorite way to make the most of a blackout?
